source_corrections: Worked example 3: append cos of the requested line angle = 1/2 to the source calculation ending at 60 degrees.
Worked example 4: replace the stray implication arrow before AE=CM by a conjunction.
Worked example 5: cosine-rule denominator is 2·EO·OB, not 2·EO·OE.
Worked example 6: HB²=AB²+AH²=5a²/4 because ABC is right at A; hence HB=a√5/2 and tan(SB,(ABC))=√15/5, not 1.
Practice 8: substitute SF²=17a²/4, not 9a²/4, in the median formula; the final source answer is unchanged.
MathType degree marks and prime notation normalized; malformed source angle accent C′AC rebuilt as a native angle hat.
Source spelling and missing inter-word spaces normalized (Tín tang → Tính tang, khi dó → khi đó, xác đinh → xác định); isolated punctuation joined to formulas.
Practice 13: restore the missing sentence separator between tan(MBK)=MK/BK and BK=BO+OK.
provenance.layout: Shared lesson template; original DXT logo and left-light/right-dark header tab; justified 14pt body; compact prompts and side-by-side solution figures. Question PDF confirmed 5 pages. Latest user-approved 6-page question edition: title 25pt with explicit two-line break; body/theory/solution leading 1.08em; theory paragraphs 3mm and display gaps 3mm; theory figures enlarged to 80/85mm; question gap 5mm. Previous compact 5-page layout superseded. Heading updated to 29pt; both explicit title lines independently stretched to available width. Both title lines now share the same font chosen to fit the longer line, at 29pt; only letter spacing varies for stretch. Writing-edition practice-section page break moved before its heading, keeping the heading with question 1. Latest answer layout: figures immediately below Lời giải, before explanation; second figure in two-part exercise remains at part b. Figure width 60mm, question 2 diagrams 50mm; worked questions 1–2 share page 2.
